generator: reversible count CTMC on original MT D_N

clock: native model time; total exit rate <= C N with one sequence-uniform finite C
edges: only count changes n->n-e_i+e_j retained in D_N

category: intrinsic diagnostic statistical-model class, not a newly adopted physical law
